name: Gmail Connector Skills
description: Use the email connector tools instead of driving the Gmail UI.
instructions:
An email account is connected, so never automate the Gmail app's UI to read or send mail — it is slow and fragile compared to the official tools.
1. To read, search, or check unread email: use list_emails and read_email.
2. To send email: use send_email. It always shows the user a confirmation dialog with recipient/subject/body before anything is sent — you don't need to ask permission separately.
3. To mark messages read/unread, use mark_email_read with the id from list_emails.
4. For real-time 'did I get an email from X' questions when notifications are enabled, read_notifications with app='gmail' can be faster than list_emails.
